text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar, currently on a two-day visit to Germany, said the pace of Slovak economic development suggests that the country could meet the EU's Maastricht criteria by the year 2000.

- The Slovak Antimonopoly Bureau said the level of competition in the chemical sector has decreased since 1995, as oil refiner Slovnaft and another major chemical firm, Duslo Sala, have strengthened their dominant positions on the domestic market.
- Slovakia is expected to announce a tender for operating a second Slovak Television channel sometime in 1997.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The Slovak branch of the troubled Czech bank Ekoagrobanka will re-open its network by October 2, after the temporary closure aimed at protecting deposits of the bank's clients.
- Industrial production accounted for 86.7 percent of Slovak output in the first half of this year.
